info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan Application By Collateral Id-spec
info.description: The Collaterals Management API allows for the deletion of loan applications associated with specific collateral items. This operation targets a loan application identified by its unique ID and the associated collateral ID, facilitating the removal of loan records that are no longer needed. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and loan service providers looking to manage and refine their loan portfolios efficiently. By ensuring the appropriate collateral removal, the API supports better asset management and compliance with lending regulations.

delete.summary: Delete collateral from a loan application.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to remove a specified collateral associated with a particular loan application. Ensure that the collateral you wish to delete is no longer needed before executing this operation.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to delete a specific collateral associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the collateral's identification details are included accurately to avoid unintentional deletions.

204.description: The collateral resource has been successfully deleted.
